item.title: Pond Flooding, 23rd November
item.description:
Source of flooding What3Words ///vies.spokes.soothing I reported a blocked drain last December 2025 on Fiddington Lane by the M5 motorway bridge, works were carried out (I think just jetting). I believe it resolved the issue as the lane has not flooded since. See attached report I sent last year for full details. However, I think we have the same issue again. The road has not yet flooded, but the track to the south of the pond is flooding. If the drain were working correctly this would not happen, particularly as we have not had much rain and the level is still rising as of Friday the 20th. It is URGENT as Fiddington Lane is closed at its northern end, and this is the only route out of Fiddington as Walton Cardiff Lane is also closed. There is a good chance that the residents of Fiddington, and some of the new developments will be stranded with no route out.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Ashchurch Rural, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Leaking stopcock outside no 14 Carenarvon close. GL513LQ, 23rd November
item.description:
Stopcock outside 14 Caernarvon Close. Severn trent supposed to fix between 6th-9th November. Job not completed as they were not able to obtain a permit. Severn trent job ref 144241170010 Reported again on 17th November, ST staff visited site. Still no resolution today and leak is now across the footpath and freezing causing safety issue. Reported again today, they will 'rebuild' the job and try to obtain permit.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 18, Caernarvon Close, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
